messages:
incident-bot: PagerDuty P1 -> network-lb-health in eu-west-1 — targets flapping, TLS handshake failures and DNS TTL=30s. Runbook: https://runbooks.internal/incidents/lb-health

pagerduty: Alert triggered: network-lb-health (policy: LB-target-health) — auto-escalation in 5m

sara.c: acked — looking. I'll gather scope. @mike.k you here?

mike.k: here, ACK. Oncall for next 30.

sara.c: initial metrics: ~17% 5xx at edge in eu-west-1 since 12:02 UTC. Error is upstream 502 from nginx. Customer-impacting.

jamal.r: rolling deploy started ~11:58 UTC for service-api. Canaries failing.

sara.c: running quick check: 
```bash
curl -s -D - https://service.example.com/health | head -n 10
HTTP/1.1 502 Bad Gateway
server: nginx
x-upstream-status: 502
``` 

sara.c: logs show upstream connection reset: 
```text
[12:03:14] upstream: "10.32.45.7:8080" connect() failed (111: Connection refused)
[12:03:14] 502 while reading response header from upstream
```

mike.k: dig from eu probe shows A records rotating rapidly TTL 30: 
```bash
dig +short service.example.com @8.8.8.8
34.120.11.7
34.120.11.8
34.120.11.9
;; TTL 30
``` 

sara.c: hypothesis: health-check path returns 502 on new runtime build -> LB marks targets unhealthy -> autoscaler/traffic manager rebalances -> DNS with low TTL amplifies oscillation.

opslead: action items: 1) remove unhealthy targets from LB (manual) 2) pause deploy/canary 3) set LB weight 0 for problem AZs 4) notify customers.

sara.c: removing 3 targets from target-group eu-west-1a now (manual API). Monitoring.

support-bot: Customer impact: 4 customers on EU region reporting increased 502s (tickets #4567 #4569). ETA channel: @account-owners pinged.

jamal.r: I've reverted the canary to previous image on cluster eu-west-1-canary -> pods are restarting.

sara.c: after removing targets + revert, backend 5xx dropped to 1.8% in 90s. still watching.

mike.k: taking over - @sara.c please handoff. I'll keep page open for next 60.

sara.c: handoff: created incident doc https://incident.internal/7480001122, added timeline + commands. Assigning to @mike.k. I'm moving to follow-up RCA.

opslead: keep DNS TTL at 30 for now (we want fast failover), but disable automatic weight-rotation for 15m to avoid flapping. ops has toggled auto-rotate = false.

mike.k: confirmed auto-rotate disabled. Also set target-weight of eu-west-1a -> 0 for 10 mins.

support-bot: sent customer status update: "We're mitigating an issue affecting EU traffic; some requests may return 502s. Engineers are working on fix. Next update in 15m." (sent to impacted accounts)

jamal.r: root cause likely nginx startup race on new runtime image + liveness probe mismatch. Will open PR to fix probe and add integration test.

sara.c: follow-up tasks created in backlog. Closing page for now but will monitor metrics for 30m. If anything recurs, PagerDuty will re-page. :thumbsup:

incident-bot: PagerDuty incident acknowledged by mike.k — incident status: mitigated (watch)

mike.k: last check: 0.3% 5xx, IOT traffic normalized. handing off to oncall weekend rotation @opslead for long tail monitoring.

opslead: acknowledged — will watch dashboards and keep support updated. Thanks team. :pray:
